description: Search verified incidents involving commercial robots and autonomous vehicles (robotaxis, delivery robots, humanoids, industrial arms, surgical and consumer robots). Every case has at least two independent sources and is followed from first report to investigation, recall, fine, lawsuit or settlement. Returns case summaries with permanent URLs; use get_case for the timeline and sources.

company.description: Company slug (e.g. waymo) or part of its name

query.description: Free text matched against title, summary, location, company and robot model

severity.description: Worst outcome recorded for the case

stage.description: How far the case has gone after the first report
